name: Syrona Health
long_description: Syrona Health’s innovative add on benefit is designed to address the critical gaps in women’s health coverage by integrating fertility, menopause, and female-specific cancer care , men's health and trans/nonbinary health. Our solution directly tackles the escalating $30B in out-of-pocket healthcare costs by offering financial protection for treatments often excluded or poorly covered by traditional health insurance.
one_liner: Employee benefit for reproductive and hormone health

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Anya is the Co-founder of Syrona Health. She is passionate about the intersection of science & technology, previously being featured on Forbes, Sifted, FT etc. She has experience in Venture Capital and in Genomics, having worked at Goldman Sachs and Illumina. She studied Bioscience at Cambridge University (Christ's College).
